comments.text: I'm an expat Australian married to a Filipina grandmother and living in Barangay Imbatug, Baungon, Bukidnon. My wife is a Higaonon baylan (shaman/healer) and is a native of Baungon. On the way from Cagayan de Oro City to Baungon, there is the Baungon Forest Park, which has statues of Higaonon people, local produce, and, of course, the Rafflesia flowers.
